on_battle_start: The sandstorm rages because I will it to. Let's see if you can stand against it.
Feel the earth itself turn against you. This is my domain now.
on_battle_won: The sands bury another challenger. Return when you can weather the storm.
You are dust before this storm. Come back stronger.
on_battle_lost: The storm bows to you, challenger. Few can claim that.
You've tamed the sandstorm itself. Onward to the next trial.
